freeze_statement: Author-defined illustration frozen after schema/metadata inspection and before computing case scores or group rankings; not an elicited or validated business norm.
primary_reference: mean score of all scored applications within this dataset and view
rank_ties: PI descending; n_cases descending; lexical group key ascending
timestamp_policy: Parse timezone-aware ISO timestamps to UTC. Span needs >=2 events and all timestamps valid. Source position is retained. Count and breadth criteria are order independent; no lifecycle interval pairing or handover sequence inferred.

bpic2012.offer_identity: No offer ID in this representation; count COMPLETE O_CREATED records, not unique offers.

C01.evidence: at least two events, every timestamp timezone-aware and valid
C01.meaning: long recorded span; not completed cycle time or SLA breach

C02.evidence: all event activity and lifecycle values present
C02.meaning: sum over W_ activities of max(number of START records minus one,0); excludes schedule and complete; recorded repeated acquisition, not unnecessary rework or effort

C03.evidence: activity/lifecycle complete, every W_ START resource present; no starts yields observed breadth zero
C03.meaning: distinct recorded W_ START resource identifiers; no human/batch classification, ownership or handover assertion

C04.evidence: activity/lifecycle complete and at least one COMPLETE O_CREATED
C04.meaning: number of recorded creation-state events; multiple offers may be legitimate, no offer identity assumed

bpic2017.offer_identity: Distinct EventID on COMPLETE O_Create Offer; require exact set equality to OfferID on COMPLETE O_Created, uniqueness of both creation-record lists, and all other O_ state OfferID values belonging to that set.

C01.evidence: at least two events, every timestamp timezone-aware and valid
C01.meaning: long recorded span; not completed cycle time or SLA breach

C02.evidence: all event activity and lifecycle values present
C02.meaning: sum over W_ activities of max(number of START records minus one,0); excludes resume, suspend, schedule, complete, withdraw and ate_abort; not necessary or unnecessary work-time estimate

C03.evidence: activity/lifecycle complete, every W_ START resource present; no starts yields observed breadth zero
C03.meaning: distinct recorded W_ START resource identifiers; no human/batch classification or ownership assertion

C04.evidence: activity/lifecycle complete and fully reconciled explicit creation IDs and offer-state IDs
C04.meaning: distinct observed offers associated with an application; legitimate options may create multiple offers

C05.evidence: all event activity and lifecycle values present
C05.meaning: number of COMPLETE A_Incomplete state records; information-follow-up indicator, not a control violation or inferred cause

limits: Not calibrated across years; different system and population.
No costs, causes, savings, loan risk, SLA or completion judgments.
Requested amount is grouping data, not processing cost or event exposure.
Cancellation, refusal and decline are not penalised.
Saturated scores cannot preserve unbounded financial severity; no mandatory veto.
No false business validation from algebraic consistency.
